services.title: Titanium Dental Implant Surgery
services.description: Restore missing teeth with medical-grade titanium implants that fuse securely with the jawbone for lifetime stability and natural chewing capability.
services.idealFor: Single or multiple missing teeth, loose denture replacement

services.title: Professional In-Office Teeth Whitening
services.description: Enamel-safe professional brightening treatment that gently lifts deep stains from coffee, tea, and age in a comfortable 45-minute clinical session.
services.idealFor: Yellowing teeth, coffee/tea stains, pre-event smile boost

services.title: Full Arch Smile Transformations
services.description: Personalized cosmetic smile enhancements combining ultra-thin porcelain veneers, composite contouring, and gum line balancing.
services.idealFor: Discolored, chipped, uneven or worn enamel

services.title: Wisdom Tooth Microsurgery
services.description: Specialized surgical removal of impacted or painful third molars using minimally invasive protocols to prevent crowding and recurrent infection.
services.idealFor: Impacted wisdom teeth, recurrent jaw pain, pericoronitis

services.title: Rotary Root Canal Therapy
services.description: Modern rotary root canal treatment to gently eliminate deep infection and relieve acute toothache while preserving your authentic tooth structure.
services.idealFor: Severe tooth pain, deep decay, heat/cold sensitivity

services.title: Zirconia & Ceramic Dental Crowns
services.description: Precision-crafted monolithic zirconia and porcelain crowns designed to reinforce weakened teeth and restore natural enamel aesthetics.
services.idealFor: Cracked teeth, post-RCT reinforcement, cosmetic gaps
